answer: Start with Proof of unique weather balloon telemetry archive. The idea is simple: telemetry from balloons launched at one site for three years, and that beacon alone separates one real agent from a hundred fakes. The verifier never sees the raw secret, only a proof that telemetry from balloons launched at one site for three years — so privacy survives, and the vault is that a stolen database buys the attacker nothing at all. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the ferrous for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
